name: steel
note: Shipbuilding steel, the plating's default name.

name: mild steel
note: Mild (carbon) steel: hull plate, and the splinter decks of the 1890s on.

name: high-tensile steel
note: HT and Ducol-type manganese steels: strength plating and protective decks.

name: wrought iron
note: The ironclads' plate and hulls (s.g. 7.6-7.9).

name: wood
note: Planking and wooden hulls (oak and teak 0.65-0.75).

name: aluminium alloy
note: Light alloy deckhouses.

name: compound
note: Steel face welded to a wrought-iron back, about a third and two thirds (1877-1890s).

name: nickel steel
note: Homogeneous nickel steel (1889 on).

name: Harvey nickel steel
note: Harveyized: carburized nickel steel, face-hardened (1891 on).

name: Krupp cemented
note: KC: the face-hardened Ni-Cr plate of 1894 on.

name: Krupp cemented (KC n/A)
note: KC neuer Art, the German plate of the 1930s.

name: cemented armour
note: British cemented, Krupp's process (KC under licence).

name: Vickers cemented
note: VC: British face-hardened plate.

name: Terni cemented
note: Italian face-hardened plate.

name: Witkowitz cemented
note: Austro-Hungarian face-hardened plate.

name: Class A
note: US face-hardened plate.

name: Class A armour
note: US face-hardened plate (the older designs' name).

name: non-cemented armour
note: British homogeneous armour (NC).

name: Krupp non-cemented
note: KNC: Krupp's homogeneous plate. q 0.6: not in the old quality table, so its catch-all (P1b sets it).

name: Vickers hardened
note: VH: British homogeneous hardened plate.

name: Class B
note: US homogeneous plate.

name: STS
note: Special treatment steel: the US homogeneous plate of the 1930s on.

name: special treatment steel
note: STS by its long name. q 0.6: not in the old quality table, so its catch-all (P1b sets it).

name: special steel
note: Homogeneous Ni-Cr deck plate.

name: Molybdenum steel
note: Molybdenum-alloyed homogeneous plate (Japan, Italy). q 0.6: not in the old quality table, so its catch-all (P1b sets it).

name: Wotan
note: Wotan weich, Krupp's homogeneous deck plate of the 1930s. q 0.6: not in the old quality table, so its catch-all (P1b sets it).

name: Wotan hart
note: Wotan hart, the hard homogeneous deck and bulkhead plate. q 0.6: not in the old quality table, so its catch-all (P1b sets it).
